metadata.description: Isolated characters from the "sitelen pona" writing system for toki pona. Submissions come on a word basis through a website. In this repository, all files are sorted in folders according to word. The prefix in each file name stands for the original word a drawing was submitted as - obviously mistaken submissions have been recategorised into the proper folder.
